cases.question: Show me all active surrogates in Screening and list their current substage.
Which IP cases are in matching right now? Include the names and emails for both IPs.
cases.title: IP Cases Currently in Matching
cases.sql:
SELECT 
    c.case_id AS case_id,
    c.case_file_name AS case_name,
    c.stage AS stage,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(c1.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(c1.last_name, ''))), '') AS ip1_name,
    c1.email AS ip1_email,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(c2.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(c2.last_name, ''))), '') AS ip2_name,
    c2.email AS ip2_email
FROM ip_case c
LEFT JOIN family f ON c.family_id = f.family_id
LEFT JOIN contact c1 ON f.ip_1_id = c1.contact_id
LEFT JOIN contact c2 ON f.ip_2_id = c2.contact_id
WHERE c.stage = 'matching'
  AND c.active = 1
ORDER BY c.case_id;
assumptions: Identified IP cases currently in matching by filtering for cases with a stage of 'matching' and active status in the Intended Parent cases records.
Intended parents (IP 1 and optional IP 2) are identified via the case's linked family record.

cases.question: Which cases have had their profiles approved in the last 30 days?
cases.title: Cases with Profiles Approved in the Last 30 Days
cases.sql:
SELECT 
    c.case_id AS `Case ID`,
    COALESCE(c.case_file_name, CONCAT(ct.first_name, ' ', ct.last_name)) AS `Case Name`,
    c.stage AS `Stage`,
    c.status AS `Status`,
    f.profile_approved AS `Profile Approved Date`
FROM ip_case c
JOIN family f ON c.family_id = f.family_id
LEFT JOIN contact ct ON f.ip_1_id = ct.contact_id
WHERE f.profile_approved >= '2026-10-21' - INTERVAL 30 DAY
ORDER BY f.profile_approved DESC
assumptions: Today is assumed to be 2026-10-21.
The last 30 days covers the period from 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-21.
Case profile approvals are tracked via the profile approval timestamp on the associated family record for intended parent cases.

cases.question: List all overdue tasks across my journeys.
cases.title: Overdue Tasks Across My Journeys
cases.sql:
SELECT
    ct.task_id AS "Task ID",
    ct.task_title AS "Task Title",
    ct.task_type AS "Task Type",
    ct.task_status AS "Task Status",
    ct.must_be_completed_by AS "Due Date",
    ct.must_be_completed_time AS "Due Time",
    COALESCE(ipc.case_file_name, gc.case_file_name, CONCAT('Case #', COALESCE(ct.ip_case_id, ct.gc_case_id))) AS "Journey / Case Name",
    CASE
        WHEN ct.ip_case_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Intended Parent'
        WHEN ct.gc_case_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Gestational Carrier'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS "Journey Type"
FROM case_task ct
LEFT JOIN ip_case ipc ON ct.ip_case_id = ipc.case_id
LEFT JOIN gc_case gc ON ct.gc_case_id = gc.case_id
LEFT JOIN case_party cp ON (cp.ip_case_id = ipc.case_id OR cp.gc_case_id = gc.case_id)
LEFT JOIN user u ON (u.user_id = cp.user_id OR u.contact_id = gc.gc_id)
WHERE ct.must_be_completed_by < '2026-10-21'
  AND ct.completed IS NULL
  AND ct.task_status != 'completed'
  AND (
      u.user_id = 'eval'
      OR ipc.assigned_admin = 'eval'
      OR gc.assigned_admin = 'eval'
      OR ct.task_assigned_to_id = 'eval'
  )
GROUP BY
    ct.task_id,
    ct.task_title,
    ct.task_type,
    ct.task_status,
    ct.must_be_completed_by,
    ct.must_be_completed_time,
    COALESCE(ipc.case_file_name, gc.case_file_name, CONCAT('Case #', COALESCE(ct.ip_case_id, ct.gc_case_id))),
    CASE
        WHEN ct.ip_case_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Intended Parent'
        WHEN ct.gc_case_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Gestational Carrier'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END
ORDER BY ct.must_be_completed_by ASC
assumptions: The user ID 'eval' represents an evaluation placeholder account not present in the user or admin records, so no journeys or tasks are linked to it, resulting in 0 rows

Tasks are considered overdue if their target completion date ('must_be_completed_by') is before 2026-10-21 and they are not marked completed (completed timestamp is null and task status is not 'completed')
'Journeys' refer to cases (intended-parent cases or gestational carrier cases) and their associated tasks in the case task tracking system
Check: The query filters by a placeholder evaluation user ID instead of the actual user's account.

cases.question: What tasks are included in the [template name] workflow?
Which contacts came in through [marketing source] and haven't completed a form since intake?
cases.title: Contacts by Marketing Source with No Form Completed Since Intake
cases.sql:
WITH first_intake AS (
    SELECT 
        uf.contact_id,
        MIN(uf.created) AS first_intake_date,
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(f.display_title, f.backend_title, CONCAT('Form #', f.form_id)) ORDER BY uf.created ASC, uf.user_form_id ASC SEPARATOR '||'), '||', 1) AS intake_form_name
    FROM user_form uf
    JOIN form f ON uf.parent_form_id = f.form_id
    WHERE f.is_intake = 1
    GROUP BY uf.contact_id
)
SELECT 
    c.contact_id AS "Contact ID",
    TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(c.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(c.last_name, ''))) AS "Contact Name",
    c.email AS "Email",
    c.phone_number AS "Phone Number",
    c.referral_source AS "Marketing / Referral Source",
    fi.intake_form_name AS "Intake Form",
    fi.first_intake_date AS "Intake Submission Date"
FROM contact c
JOIN first_intake fi ON c.contact_id = fi.contact_id
LEFT JOIN user_form uf_later 
    ON c.contact_id = uf_later.contact_id 
    AND uf_later.created > fi.first_intake_date
WHERE c.referral_source IS NOT NULL
  AND uf_later.user_form_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.referral_source ASC, "Contact Name" ASC;
assumptions: 'marketing source' refers to the contact's recorded referral source (e.g., search, Search Engine, Facebook, media, social_media, etc.). Since no specific marketing source was specified in '[marketing source]', all contacts with a recorded referral source are included and grouped/sorted by referral source
'intake' is identified by form submissions where the form is flagged as an intake form (is_intake = 1), using the contact's earliest intake form submission date
'haven\'t completed a form since intake' means the contact has no subsequent form submissions created after their initial intake form submission

cases.question: List egg donors available for a cycle who haven't donated before.
cases.title: Available First-Time Egg Donors
cases.sql:
SELECT 
    c.case_id AS case_id,
    c.case_file_name AS case_name,
    ct.first_name AS first_name,
    ct.last_name AS last_name,
    ct.email AS email,
    ct.phone_number AS phone_number,
    c.stage AS current_stage,
    c.donor_status AS donor_status,
    ep.profile_id AS profile_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN ep.past_donor = 0 THEN 'No'
        WHEN ep.past_donor = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS past_donor
FROM gc_case c
JOIN contact ct 
    ON c.gc_id = ct.contact_id
JOIN ed_profile ep 
    ON c.gc_id = ep.contact_id
LEFT JOIN retrieval r 
    ON r.ed_case_id = c.case_id
WHERE c.case_type = 'donor'
  AND c.active = 1
  AND c.donor_status = 'available'
  AND ep.past_donor = 0
  AND r.retrieval_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.case_id ASC
assumptions: Egg donors are identified by donor cases in the cases table (case_type = 'donor') linked to an egg donor profile (ed_profile).
Availability for a cycle is determined by a donor status of 'available' on the donor case record.
Donors who haven't donated before are identified by ed_profile.past_donor = 0 and having no prior retrieval records.
Only active cases (active = 1) are included.

cases.question: Which contracts are still waiting on a signature?
cases.title: Contracts Waiting on Signature
cases.sql:
SELECT 
    cr.relationship_id AS contract_relationship_id,
    cr.parent_id AS hellosign_id,
    h.signature_request_id,
    cr.status AS signature_status,
    cr.created AS date_sent,
    cr.user_type AS signer_type,
    cr.user_id AS signer_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN cr.user_type = 'user' THEN CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name)
        WHEN cr.user_type = 'admin' THEN CONCAT(a.first_name, ' ', a.last_name)
        WHEN cr.user_type = 'np_user' THEN CONCAT(unp.first_name, ' ', unp.last_name)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS signer_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN cr.user_type = 'user' THEN u.email
        WHEN cr.user_type = 'admin' THEN a.email
        WHEN cr.user_type = 'np_user' THEN unp.email
        ELSE NULL
    END AS signer_email
FROM contract_rel cr
JOIN hellosign h ON cr.parent_id = h.hellosign_id
LEFT JOIN user u ON cr.user_id = u.user_id AND cr.user_type = 'user'
LEFT JOIN admin a ON cr.user_id = a.admin_id AND cr.user_type = 'admin'
LEFT JOIN user_np unp ON cr.user_id = unp.np_user_id AND cr.user_type = 'np_user'
WHERE cr.status = 'sent'
ORDER BY cr.created DESC
assumptions: Contracts waiting on a signature are identified as contract relationship records in 'sent' status where the signature has not yet been completed.
Signers are matched based on user type to regular users, non-portal/partner users, or admin staff.

cases.question: Show me which intended parents have never logged into their portal.
cases.title: Intended Parents Who Have Never Logged In
cases.sql:
SELECT 
  u.user_id AS `User ID`,
  u.first_name AS `First Name`,
  u.last_name AS `Last Name`,
  u.email AS `Email`,
  c.phone_number AS `Phone Number`,
  u.created AS `Account Created Date`
FROM user u
LEFT JOIN contact c ON u.contact_id = c.contact_id
WHERE u.user_type = 'IP'
  AND u.last_login IS NULL
ORDER BY u.created DESC
assumptions: Intended parents are identified by the user account type 'IP' (or 'IP rep' if including representatives; here focused on intended parent user accounts with user_type = 'IP')
A user who has never logged into their portal has a null last login timestamp

cases.question: Which cases have active, incomplete campaigns right now?
cases.title: Cases with Active Incomplete Campaigns
cases.sql:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(gc.case_id, ipc.case_id) AS case_id,
    COALESCE(gc.case_file_name, ipc.case_file_name) AS case_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN gc.case_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'GC Case'
        WHEN ipc.case_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'IP Case'
    END AS case_type,
    c.internal_title AS campaign_name,
    cc.flow_status AS campaign_flow_status,
    cc.created AS campaign_start_date,
    cc.flow_date AS next_flow_date
FROM case_campaign cc
JOIN campaign c ON cc.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN gc_case gc ON cc.assigned_gc_case = gc.case_id
LEFT JOIN ip_case ipc ON cc.assigned_ip_case = ipc.case_id
WHERE cc.active = 1
  AND c.active = 1
  AND cc.completed IS NULL
  AND cc.flow_status NOT IN ('finished', 'finished_by_trigger', 'stopped')
  AND (gc.case_id IS NOT NULL OR ipc.case_id IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY cc.created DESC
assumptions: An active campaign refers to campaign definitions where the active flag is set to true (1) and case campaign enrollments marked active (1).

An incomplete campaign refers to case campaign enrollments that have not been completed (completed timestamp is NULL) and whose workflow status is still pending/active (not finished, finished_by_trigger, or stopped).
Cases linked through both gestational carrier cases (GC) and intended parent cases (IP) are evaluated and returned.

cases.question: How many open To Dos does each admin currently have assigned to them?
cases.title: Open To-Dos Assigned per Admin
cases.sql:
SELECT
    a.admin_id,
    CONCAT(a.first_name, ' ', a.last_name) AS admin_name,
    a.email,
    COUNT(t.task_id) AS open_todos_count
FROM admin a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT task_id, task_assigned_to_id
    FROM case_task
    WHERE completed IS NULL AND task_status != 'completed'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT task_id, task_assigned_to_id
    FROM general_task
    WHERE completed IS NULL AND task_status != 'completed'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT task_id, task_assigned_to_id
    FROM contact_task
    WHERE completed IS NULL AND task_status != 'completed'
) t ON a.admin_id = t.task_assigned_to_id
WHERE a.soft_deleted = 0
GROUP BY
    a.admin_id,
    a.first_name,
    a.last_name,
    a.email
ORDER BY
    open_todos_count DESC,
    admin_name ASC;
assumptions: Tasks/To-Dos include all assigned action items and tasks tracked across cases (case_task), general tasks (general_task), and contact follow-ups (contact_task).
Open To Dos are defined as tasks that have not been completed (completed timestamp is null and task status is not 'completed').
All administrators are included, with a count of 0 if they currently have no open To Dos assigned.

cases.question: Which surrogates are still waiting on their profile to be approved?
cases.title: Surrogates Awaiting Profile Approval
cases.sql:
SELECT 
    c.contact_id AS `Contact ID`,
    TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(c.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(c.last_name, ''))) AS `Surrogate Name`,
    c.email AS `Email`,
    c.phone_number AS `Phone Number`,
    COUNT(gc.case_id) AS `Active Case Count`,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT gc.stage ORDER BY gc.stage SEPARATOR ', ') AS `Stages`,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.status ORDER BY s.status SEPARATOR ', ') AS `Statuses`,
    MIN(gc.created) AS `Earliest Case Created Date`
FROM contact c
JOIN gc_case gc ON gc.gc_id = c.contact_id AND gc.case_type = 'surrogate' AND gc.active = 1
LEFT JOIN status s ON gc.status_id = s.status_id
WHERE c.gc_profile_approved IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    c.contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    c.phone_number
ORDER BY `Earliest Case Created Date` DESC
assumptions: Surrogates are identified from contacts linked to active surrogate cases.
Waiting on profile approval is identified where the profile approval date (gc_profile_approved) is not yet recorded.
Results are aggregated to one row per surrogate contact, summarizing their associated active surrogate cases, stages, and statuses.

cases.question: Show me egg donor profiles that haven't been approved by the agency yet.
cases.title: Egg Donor Profiles Pending Agency Approval
cases.sql:
SELECT 
    p.profile_id AS profile_id,
    c.contact_id AS contact_id,
    CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) AS full_name,
    c.email AS email,
    c.phone_number AS phone_number,
    s.status AS contact_status,
    p.user_submitted AS is_user_submitted,
    p.residency_status AS residency_status,
    p.current_city AS current_city,
    p.blood_type AS blood_type,
    p.frozen_egg_count AS frozen_egg_count,
    c.created AS contact_created_at
FROM ed_profile p
JOIN contact c ON p.contact_id = c.contact_id
LEFT JOIN status s ON c.status_id = s.status_id
WHERE c.ed_profile_approved IS NULL
ORDER BY p.profile_id ASC
assumptions: Egg donor profiles are identified from the egg donor profile table (ed_profile) linked to their respective contact records.
Approval by the agency is tracked via the egg donor profile approval timestamp (contact.ed_profile_approved); profiles lacking this timestamp are considered not yet approved.

cases.question: Pull a list of sperm donors whose profiles are pending approval.
cases.title: Sperm Donors Pending Profile Approval
cases.sql:
SELECT
    c.contact_id AS donor_id,
    c.first_name AS first_name,
    c.last_name AS last_name,
    c.email AS email,
    c.phone_number AS phone_number,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT gc.stage ORDER BY gc.stage SEPARATOR ', ') AS case_stages,
    s.status AS contact_status,
    c.sd_profile_approved AS profile_approved_date,
    c.created AS registered_date
FROM contact c
JOIN gc_case gc 
    ON c.contact_id = gc.gc_id 
    AND gc.case_type = 'sperm_donor'
LEFT JOIN status s 
    ON c.status_id = s.status_id
WHERE c.sd_profile_approved IS NULL
GROUP BY
    c.contact_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    c.phone_number,
    s.status,
    c.sd_profile_approved,
    c.created
ORDER BY c.created DESC
assumptions: Sperm donors are identified by having a sperm donor case record
A profile is pending approval when the sperm donor profile approval timestamp has not yet been set (is null)
Results are grouped at the individual donor level to ensure unique records if a donor is associated with multiple cases
Check: The list includes disqualified donors and those not awaiting approval because it treats any donor without an approval date as pending.

cases.question: Show me intended parents whose profile has been approved.
cases.title: Intended Parents with Approved Profiles
cases.sql:
SELECT 
    f.family_id AS `Family ID`,
    CONCAT(c1.first_name, ' ', c1.last_name) AS `Primary Intended Parent`,
    c1.email AS `Primary IP Email`,
    c1.phone_number AS `Primary IP Phone`,
    CONCAT(c2.first_name, ' ', c2.last_name) AS `Secondary Intended Parent`,
    c2.email AS `Secondary IP Email`,
    c2.phone_number AS `Secondary IP Phone`,
    f.profile_approved AS `Profile Approved Date`
FROM family f
JOIN contact c1 ON f.ip_1_id = c1.contact_id
LEFT JOIN contact c2 ON f.ip_2_id = c2.contact_id
WHERE f.profile_approved IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.profile_approved DESC;
assumptions: Intended parents are tracked through family records where the profile approval date is recorded, linked to the primary intended parent (IP 1) and optional second intended parent (IP 2).
Filtered for intended parent families whose profile approval date is populated.
